character_profiles.name: Bolt
character_profiles.face_details: Large, expressive blue LED screen eyes that display emotions, simple curved digital mouth
character_profiles.hair: None (single drooping copper antenna with a small light tip)
character_profiles.outfit: Exposed retro matte-gray metal plates, brass gears at joints, and soft copper accents
character_profiles.distinguishing_features: Slightly rusty joints, a single antenna that droops to show shyness, and oversized glowing blue eyes
character_profiles.reference_prompt: A character concept sheet of Bolt, a small retro-styled robot with a boxy matte-gray and brass metallic body, standing in a shy pose. It has large, expressive glowing blue LED screen eyes that convey a gentle, timid emotion, and a single slightly drooping copper antenna on its head. The design is semi-stylized in a 3D animated Pixar style with warm, realistic studio lighting, soft metallic textures, and a clean studio background.

character_profiles.name: Spark
character_profiles.build: Sleek, slender, aerodynamic, and highly agile chassis
character_profiles.face_details: Smooth white faceplate with a sleek dark visor displaying shifting neon pink and cyan patterns
character_profiles.outfit: Glossy white and obsidian black armor plating with integrated glowing neon light strips
character_profiles.distinguishing_features: Vibrant glowing neon pink and cyan energy lines tracing its limbs and dynamic joints
character_profiles.reference_prompt: A character concept sheet of Spark, a sleek and charismatic dancer robot with a slender, athletic build made of glossy white and black high-tech polymers. Its body is adorned with vibrant, glowing neon pink and cyan lines that trace its limbs. It has a smooth faceplate with a sleek visor displaying shifting neon patterns. The design is semi-stylized in a 3D animated Pixar style, featuring warm realistic lighting, emissive neon glow reflections on its glossy chassis, and a clean studio background.
